newsitem.title: UK: SIG to pump SIGAP proceeds into acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: SIG to pump SIGAP proceeds into acquisitions.

text.p: British insulation products manufacturer SIG Plc said on Monday it would most likely plough back all the proceeds from its SIGAP disposal into new acquisitions in Germany, France or Britain.

"We're looking closer to what we do which is multi-site distribution of building products, mainly insulation, ceilings and partitions. These are our main businesses and we are looking to reinvest the proceeds in similar businesses," SIG chief executive Bill Forrester said in a telephone interview.
Earlier on Monday SIG said it had conditionally agreed to a management buy-out of its hardware and security division SIGAP for 65 million stg.
Forrester said SIG had become dissatisfied with the division's performance.
